name: speaker_owner_absent
description: One batch-lane recording of two real voices (public LibriSpeech, 34 s) in which the owner never speaks: an enrolled person and a stranger take turns while the owner's pendant records. The owner and the person are enrolled. The batch lane diarizes through the speaker peer (production's community-1 answer, from a committed cassette) and the product's resolver and batch final pass label the voices. No word may be labelled as the owner, the enrolled person must be named, and the stranger must not get a name. Receipts are as production's projection writes them (naming the recording); the v3 conversation reads them as its own source recording's. Before that fix, load_reference answered skipped_merged and no voice was named (measured 2026-11-26).

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 on the lab host, --stt replay --speakers replay (180 reads, 60 writes, 1 delete(s), 4 no-op, 1 STT cassette play, 6 LLM; caps about +10%).
